name: Shenzhen Lihexing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Lihexing Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and located in Shenzhen, China, is dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced automated and intelligent equipment. The company primarily serves China's information and communication technology (ICT) industry. Its comprehensive product offerings encompass a variety of specialized machinery, such as stud welding systems, flexible OLED screen laminators, automated LCD panel exposure units, and soft pack battery testing apparatus. They also supply automatic plastic packaging solutions, sophisticated 5G dielectric filter test and adjustment tools, and provide tailored non-standard equipment, alongside operating a product transfer platform. These solutions are integral to both the inspection and production processes of mobile smart terminals and crucial network infrastructure devices.
